name: Nii-chan no Oyome-san wa Hentai-san ~Kawaii Boku-chan, Itadakimasu♪~
original_name: にいちゃんのお嫁さんはヘンタイさん～可愛いボクちゃん、いただきます♪～
source:
My brother “Harukyaku” is getting married.
He told me that he is marrying his older boss, but I have not met him yet.
What kind of person is my brother’s wife?
My brother said she was very beautiful, so I’m curious.

And the day came when I was to live with the person.
My name is Ikuya. I’m going to be your family member from now on, okay?

Then one day, “Koma” was napping.
…… for some reason it was hard for her to breathe.
I opened my eyes for a moment to see what was going on, and then I saw big boobs in front of me.
And then I heard “Ikuya’s” voice……

“ughhhh…… I want to eat you with your pretty face……”
